concerns.text: Task T031 (Null Model comparison) depends on T014b1/T014b2 (Null Model generation) which are listed in Phase 3 (US1) but marked as unimplemented `[ ]`. T031 cannot execute until the Null Model data artifacts are produced. The dependency chain is broken: T031 -> T014b (US1) -> T011 (US1). Since T014b is not in the 'Implementation' list for US1 (only T011-T013 are checked), the consumer (T031) is scheduled before the producer (T014b) is guaranteed to exist.

Task T028c (Pre-computed CAMB Likelihood Grid) is listed as a prerequisite for T028b (Parameter Estimation). However, T028c is an unimplemented task `[ ]` with no explicit dependency on the pilot run (T007) or budget check (T033). If the grid generation is computationally expensive (as noted in the Analyze Report), it must be part of the budget calculation or run as a separate pre-phase. Currently, T028b depends on T028c, but T028c has no defined execution order relative to the budget constraints, risking a runtime violation before the main analysis even starts.

Task T033 (Budget Check) depends on T007 (Pilot Runner) and T011 (Simulation). T007 is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented) in Phase 2. T033 is marked `[X]` (checked) but logically cannot run without the pilot output. The ordering implies T033 is ready, but its producer (T007) is not. This creates a semantic violation where a blocking prerequisite task is marked complete while its dependency is pending.

Task T029b1 (Define Regression) depends on T031 (Null Model comparison) according to the 'Specific Task Dependencies' section. However, T031 depends on T029a (Bias Calc). This creates a circular or ambiguous dependency: T029b1 -> T031 -> T029a. But T029a (Bias Calc) is the output of T028b. The regression definition (T029b1) logically requires the bias data (T029a) to be available to define the model formula correctly. The current ordering places T029b1 as dependent on T031, which is dependent on T029a, but the text description of T029b1 says 'Depends on T031 (or T029a...)', creating ambiguity in the execution order.

Task T012 defines gap fractions as a 'range of discrete thresholds' but does not explicitly link to the specific values used in T014a1/a2/a3. While T012 is marked `[X]`, the specific values are `[deferred]` in the spec. The task order assumes the values are known for T014, but the definition task (T012) does not produce the concrete values needed by the implementation tasks (T014). This is a semantic gap in the artifact flow: the 'definition' task does not emit the 'values' artifact required by the 'implementation' tasks.
